sentences.en: In the experiment, the independent variable was the amount of sunlight.
sentences.zh: 在这项实验中，自变量是阳光的多少。

sentences.en: For our project, we'll change the temperature to see its effect on plant growth as the independent variable.
sentences.zh: 在我们的项目中，我们将改变温度来看看它对植物生长的影响，其中温度是自变量。

sentences.en: The study manipulated time spent studying as the independent variable to measure test scores.
sentences.zh: 这项研究将学习时间作为自变量来测量考试成绩。
